How many Data Scientist jobs are open in the United States?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $107,500–$187,200 a year, based on 18 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for Data Scientist jobs in the United States?
